observations: Sony PlayStation 5 console (original model) wrapped in protective plastic film.
Disc drive slot is visible on the right side of the console in photo 0.
Two DualSense wireless controllers are present: one black and one white.
The setting is a retail shop with a sign for 'Float Expertech Ventures (NIG)' in Owerri, Imo State.
The console appears used but is presented as refurbished or protected for sale.

claims.evidence: Requires a photo of the System Software version in the settings menu.
FIFA 26 does not exist; the current series has transitioned to 'EA Sports FC'.
No photos of the console screen showing the game library.

risks.proof: Photo of Settings > System > System Software showing a firmware version compatible with current exploits (e.g., 4.51 or lower).
Video of a game disc being inserted and the game launching.
Video of the controllers being used to navigate the menu without ghost inputs.

risks.risk: Console is banned from PlayStation Network
risks.proof: Video showing the console successfully connecting to the PlayStation Store.

proof_requests: Photo of the 'Console Information' screen showing the System Software version.
Video of the console turned on showing the installed games list.
Video demonstrating the disc drive reading a game disc.
response.reason: The item is clearly a Sony PlayStation 5 Disc Edition. While the 'hacked' claim is unverified and the game list contains errors, the hardware is identifiable and can be priced at its base used value.
